description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Kirimetiya, Kandy Four Gravets and Gangawata Koralaya D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320301
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, owner names, and title classifications. The content focuses on land ownership, title registration, and property rights - all falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
